catalog_texts_field.name: catalog_texts_field
catalog_texts_field.value: ("catalog_texts"."entity_kind" = 'course' AND "catalog_texts"."field" IN ('displayTitle', 'shelfTitle', 'subtitle', 'billboardDescription', 'billboardDescriptionMobile', 'description', 'descriptionMobile', 'about', 'level', 'format')) OR ("catalog_texts"."entity_kind" = 'lesson' AND "catalog_texts"."field" IN ('displayTitle', 'about')) OR ("catalog_texts"."entity_kind" = 'author' AND "catalog_texts"."field" IN ('bio'))

catalog_texts_approval.name: catalog_texts_approval
catalog_texts_approval.value: ("catalog_texts"."status" = 'approved' AND "catalog_texts"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_texts"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_texts"."approved_sha256" = "catalog_texts"."text_sha256") OR ("catalog_texts"."status" = 'draft' AND "catalog_texts"."approved_by" IS NULL AND "catalog_texts"."approved_at" IS NULL AND "catalog_texts"."approved_sha256" IS NULL)

courses_subarea_area.name: courses_subarea_area
courses_subarea_area.value: "courses"."subarea_id" IS NULL OR "courses"."area_id" IS NOT NULL

courses_published_rights.name: courses_published_rights
courses_published_rights.value: "courses"."status" <> 'published' OR ("courses"."license_code" IS NOT NULL AND "courses"."source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "courses"."canonical_url" IS NOT NULL AND "courses"."rights_status" IN ('cleared', 'accepted-risk'))

home_rows_shape.name: home_rows_shape
home_rows_shape.value: ("home_rows"."kind" = 'author' AND "home_rows"."author_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("home_rows"."kind" = 'curated' AND "home_rows"."title" IS NOT NULL AND "home_rows"."author_id" IS NULL) OR ("home_rows"."kind" = 'continue' AND "home_rows"."author_id" IS NULL)
